|Stage|Description|Average Age (years)|
|---|---|---|
|I|Prepubertal (no glandular tissue)|<8|
|II|Breast bud (thelarche)|8–13 (mean ~10–11)|
|III|Further enlargement|11–12|
|IV|Areola/papilla form secondary mound|12–13|
|V|Mature adult breast|13–15|
